name: Instagram Terms of Service
documentText:
Welcome to Instagram.
These Terms of Use govern your use of Instagram.
We do not claim ownership of your content, but you grant us a non-exclusive, fully paid and royalty-free, transferable, sub-licensable, worldwide license to use the Content that you post on or in connection with Instagram. We can remove any content or information you share on the Service if we believe that it violates these Terms of Use, our policies, or we are permitted or required to do so by law. You waive your right to a class action lawsuit and agree to resolve all disputes through individual arbitration.

recommendations.title: Broad Content License
recommendations.roastTitle: You're Making Zuckerberg Rich For Free
recommendations.currentText: you grant us a non-exclusive, fully paid and royalty-free, transferable, sub-licensable, worldwide license to use the Content that you post
recommendations.proposedText: you grant us a limited, revocable, non-transferable license to display your Content solely for the purpose of operating the Instagram Service. This license terminates when you delete your Content.
recommendations.legalBasis: The current broad license effectively strips creators of exclusive commercial rights to their own photography. Meta can sub-license your content to third parties without paying you.
recommendations.roastComment: Wow, so they can take that photo of your dog, slap it on a billboard in Tokyo, sub-license it to a dog food company, and you get absolutely nothing. Brilliant.

recommendations.title: Class Action Waiver
recommendations.currentText: You waive your right to a class action lawsuit and agree to resolve all disputes through individual arbitration.
recommendations.proposedText: Users retain the right to participate in class action lawsuits for widespread data breaches or systematic privacy violations.
recommendations.legalBasis: Class action waivers force users into private arbitration where corporate entities win the vast majority of cases. It prevents collective legal action against systemic abuses.
recommendations.roastComment: If they leak the passwords of a million people, you all have to sue them individually. It's the legal equivalent of divide and conquer.

companyRecommendations.title: Protect Corporate Interests: Broad Content License
companyRecommendations.currentText: you grant us a non-exclusive, fully paid and royalty-free, transferable, sub-licensable, worldwide license to use the Content that you post
companyRecommendations.proposedText: Ensure this clause is as broad as legally permissible to maximize operational flexibility and limit corporate liability.
companyRecommendations.legalBasis: From the company's perspective, this clause provides essential protection against unpredictable user behavior and class action lawsuits. We recommend strengthening this clause rather than diluting it.
companyRecommendations.roastComment: Keep it broad. We hold the cards.
